svg.text: ENTERPRISE FIELD SERVICE TECHNICIAN COPILOT: OFFLINE EDGE RAG & VAN-STOCK DISPATCH
Pre-Dispatch Van-Stock Check + Offline 4B SLM/SQLite-Vec Hits 95.8% First-Time Fix Rate
8,000 Technicians / 180K Work Orders/Mo: Tier 1 Cloud-Only Bot (38% Dead-Zone Fail, $380K/mo) vs. Tier 2 Text-Only vs. Tier 4 ($42K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Basement Blackouts & Repeat Rolls
1. Cloud-Only API RAG in Dead Zones (38.0% Offline Blackout):
• Hospital MRI basements, factory Faraday cages & wind turbines
have zero cellular signal—cloud-only bots fail when needed most!
2. Text-Only Chunking Strips Exploded Drawings (31% Wrong Part):
• Technicians need Callout Balloon `#14` on `DWG-882` mapped to the
machine's exact serial-number BOM, not generic prose
3. Diagnosing Only After Driving 90 Min On-Site (19.5% Repeat Roll):
• Tech finds the bad valve on site, but doesn't have it in the van!
Production Failure Impact (8,000 Techs / 180K Work Orders/Mo):
• First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR): Only 73.5% (26.5% repeat truck rolls!)
• Dead-Zone Availability: 62.0% (Tier 1) | Wrong Part: 31.0% (Tier 2)
• Monthly Repeat Truck-Roll & Parts Return TCO: $380,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Pre-Dispatch Van-Stock + Offline Edge SLM
1. Pre-Dispatch IoT Triage & Van-Stock Inventory Match (95.8% FTFR):
• Maps IoT fault code -> top 2 likely parts & verifies technician
van inventory BEFORE dispatching the truck (4.2% repeat rolls!)
2. Depot Wi-Fi Route Sync (`4B INT4 SLM + SQLite-Vec`, 100% Offline):
• Pre-syncs 180MB delta bundle for the day's 6 assigned asset serials;
runs 100% offline on tablet NPU/GPU in basements (420ms latency)
3. Interactive Exploded-View Callout-to-BOM Pinning + LOTO Gate:
• Tapping Callout `#14` locks serial P/N (`1.2%` error) + LOTO interlock
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR): 95.8% (+22.3 pts vs. Tier 1)
• Offline Availability: 100.0% | Wrong Part Rate: 1.2%
• Monthly Total TCO: $42,000 / mo (-88.9% savings vs. Tier 1)
